completion_data.completion_summary: Executed all seven phases of the convex-history study. Established with machine-checked probes that the current semantics at a bounded convex index is a third, unintended reading at which TM's modal_t axiom is false; defined and separated four consequence relations, proving F-top C1-valid and C3-invalid and that box-of-any-binary-tense-formula is C3-unsatisfiable because germs are always in C3's box range; audited all 45 Axiom constructors under C3 (36 survive, 6 machine-checked failures, all of them existence assertions about the temporal order) after proving C3 truth translation-invariant, which settles modal_future as surviving; proved presheaf functoriality and the Germs clause of app:presheaf-dictionary against the live tree, and mapped app:Structure onto the repository in both directions. Verdict: DEVELOP-AND-RETARGET, with eight follow-on task specifications, a paste-ready revised task description, and seven explicitly unsettled items. No file under FormalSystem/ was modified.

user_decision.question: Should C3's box quantify over ALL convex histories whose domain contains the evaluation time -- the paper's line-1102 footnote reading, which includes one-point germs and therefore makes every boxed binary-tense formula unsatisfiable -- or over a cut-back range that excludes the degenerate indices?
options: Keep the footnote's reading as the primary C3 and add the restricted variant as a named alternative
Make a cut-back range (e.g. interval sections of some minimum length, or sections whose domain contains dom tau) the primary C3
Investigate both before committing, as part of follow-on task F
user_decision.recommended: Keep the footnote's reading as the primary C3 and add the restricted variant as a named alternative
